# ipam_pool (Data Source)

Reads a pool and its current allocations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ipam_pool" "uks" {
  id = "uks"
}

output "uks_cidrs" {
  value = data.ipam_pool.uks.cidrs
}

# Allocation ID to CIDR, including child-pool carve-outs.
output "uks_allocations" {
  value = data.ipam_pool.uks.allocations
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Pool ID.

### Read-Only

- `allocations` (Map of String) Allocation ID to CIDR, including child-pool carve-outs (IDs `pool:<child>:<incarnation>`).
- `cidrs` (Set of String) The pool's CIDRs.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `family` (Number) Address family: 4 or 6.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `parent_pool` (String) Parent pool ID; null for a root pool.
